Name: Ant Effect
Desc: For every **1-Cost character** on the field, this character's On-Field/Off-Field Strength increases by <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak>. A 3-star 1-Cost character provides 2 stacks of this buff.

Name: Refresh Visioscape
Desc:
When entering a new Node, if this character participated in the previous battle, gains <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> free refresh(es).
When refreshing, the ally squad's On/Off-Field Strength increases by <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak>.

Name: Social Expert
Desc: Every <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> times the Store is refreshed, 1 other character sharing any of this character's Bonds is guaranteed to appear.

Name: Battlefield Scholar
Desc:
When entering a new Node, if this character participated in the previous battle, they gain <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> Experience.
For every 1 Store level, the ally squad's On-Field/Off-Field Strength increases by <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak>.

Name: Battlefield Scholar: Elite
Desc:
When entering a new Node, if this character participated in the previous battle, they gain <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> Experience.
For every 1 Store level, the ally squad's On-Field/Off-Field Strength increases by <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak>.

Name: Self-Copy
Desc: Every time after entering N new Nodes, gain 1 copy of this unit, where N is equal to this unit's cost.

Name: Lead Hunter
Desc: Upon a Perfect Clear, obtain <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> random characters of the same cost. After failing combat, reselect Plot Armor.

Name: Refresh Visioscape: Ascension
Desc:
When entering a new Node, if this character participated in the previous Combat, gains <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> free refresh(es).
When refreshing, the ally squad's On/Off-Field Strength increases by <unbreak>2[f1]%</unbreak>.

Name: Race Against Death
Desc: For every <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> squad HP lost, this character gains a <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak> SPD Amplification and grants the ally squad <unbreak>3[i]%</unbreak> DMG Mitigation and DMG Amplification.

Name: Gold-Hoarding Hero
Desc: For every 1 Gold Coin in possession, this character gains <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> On-Field/Off-Field Strength (up to <unbreak>2[i]</unbreak> Gold Coins taken into account). This character gains <unbreak>3[i]%</unbreak> DMG Amplification.

Name: Full-Attendance Base
Desc: When entering a new Node, if this character participated in the previous battle, gains <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> Gold Coins.

Name: Nano Component
Desc: When entering combat, 1 piece of this character's advanced equipment is temporarily upgraded to privileged equipment.

Name: Invitation
Desc: Obtain a random Bond Emblem for this character.

Name: Symbiotic Battlesuit
Desc: This character unequips all gear and equips a full set of recommended gear that cannot be modified or removed.

Name: Fragility Killer
Desc:
This character's attacks inflict "Fragility" on enemies, increasing DMG received by <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak>. When the ally squad attacks enemies with "Weaken," DMG Amplification increases by <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak>.

***"Weaken" can be obtained via "<gridfightinfo type=item id=35030607>."***

Name: Weaken Hunter
Desc:
While this character is on the field, enemies are inflicted with "Weaken," reducing their DMG dealt by <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> × this character's cost, and increasing the DMG taken by enemies with "Fragility" by <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak> × this character's cost.

***"Fragility" can be obtained via "<gridfightinfo type=item id=35030104>" and "<gridfightinfo type=item id=35030708>."***

Name: Confidence Incentive
Desc: After this character uses an ability on an ally target, their On-Field Strength increases by <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> and grants <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak> DMG Mitigation, lasting for <unbreak>3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

Name: Swift Entry
Desc: At the start of combat, this character activates their Ultimate and grants a <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> DMG Amplification to the ally squad.

Name: Endfire
Desc:
After this character uses their Ultimate, fires <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> Fireballs. Each use fires 1 extra Fireball.
Each "Fireball" deals Fire DMG equal to <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak> of this character's ATK to one random enemy.

Name: Creeping Frost
Desc:
Taking into account the DoT dealt by this character, when the accumulated value reaches <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> base DMG, "Creeping Frost" deals Ice DMG equal to <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak> base DMG, distributed among all enemy targets.
After "Creeping Frost" is triggered, the accumulated value required for subsequent triggers increases by <unbreak>3[i]%</unbreak> base DMG, and it additionally deals a <unbreak>4[i]%</unbreak> base DMG.

Name: Rushing Partygoer
Desc: This character gains a <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> SPD Amplification, and gains <unbreak>2[i]</unbreak> Punchline at the start of "Aha Instant."

Name: Recall Invoker
Desc: This character gains <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> On-Field/Off-Field Strength. In combat, whenever a memosprite is summoned, this character and their memosprite additionally gain <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak> On-Field/Off-Field Strength.

Name: Scar Breaker
Desc: Increases this character's Weakness Break Efficiency by <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak>. When triggering Weakness Break, gains a <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak> Break DMG Amplification, stackable up to <unbreak>3[i]</unbreak> times.

Name: Wild Gale Fist
Desc:
This character gains <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> "Combo Rate" when using Basic ATK, and a <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak> SPD and DMG Amplification after using Basic ATK, stackable up to <unbreak>3[i]</unbreak> times.
During auto-battle, this character will prioritize using Basic ATK.

Name: Lucky Dog
Desc: Increases Lucky Strike Rate by <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak>.

Name: Turbocharge
Desc: Gains <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> SPD Amplification. During battle, for every <unbreak>100</unbreak> SPD this character has, On-Field/Off-Field Strength increases by <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak>.

Name: Grow With the Fight
Desc: For every <unbreak>10</unbreak> enemy difficulty, this character's On-Field/Off-Field Strength increases by <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak>. When enemy difficulty reaches <unbreak>60</unbreak>/<unbreak>120</unbreak>/<unbreak>160</unbreak>, this bonus doubles.

Name: On-Field Expert
Desc: This character gains <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> On-Field Strength. In battle, On-Field Strength additionally increases by an amount equal to <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak> of the original On-Field Strength increase percentage.

Name: Off-Field Expert
Desc: This character gains <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> Off-Field Strength. In combat, Off-Field Strength additionally increases by an amount equal to <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak> of the original Off-Field Strength increase percentage.

Name: In Full Bloom
Desc: This character gains a <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> HP Amplification and additionally increasing by <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak> for each "<gridfightinfo type=item id=350205>" equipped.

Name: Walking With Wings
Desc: This character gains a <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> SPD Amplification and additionally increases by <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak> for each "<gridfightinfo type=item id=350201>" equipped.

Name: Ultimate on Elites
Desc: This character gains <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> DMG Amplification and <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak> Ultimate DMG Amplification.

Name: Ward keeper
Desc: This character gains <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> healing and Shield strength, distributes <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak> of the DMG taken by on-field characters while on-field, and takes no action value penalty when receiving a killing blow.

Name: Reaper
Desc: After this character attacks an enemy target, "Executes" them if their HP percentage is below <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak>. Gains <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak> DMG Amplification.

Name: Black Hole Gravity
Desc: After this character uses their Ultimate, **delays the countdown** to the end of combat by <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> action value. This can be triggered up to <unbreak>2[i]</unbreak> time(s) per battle.

Name: Wealth Keeper's Dream Bubble
Desc:
Max Interest increases to 8 Gold Coins. For every 1 Interest earned, there is a <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak> chance to get 1 free refresh.
For every 1 Gold Coin, the character's On-Field/Off-Field Strength increases by <unbreak>3[i]%</unbreak>.

Name: Patricide Prince
Desc: This character gains <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> Lucky Strike DMG, and further gains <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak> Lucky Strike DMG in Encounter/Boss Nodes.

Name: Sun-Chasing
Desc: For every <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> time(s) this character takes action, their action advances by <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak>.

Name: Drysea Walker
Desc: This character cannot regenerate Energy. Gains <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> On-Field/Off-Field Strength and <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak> DMG Amplification.

Name: Spiritual Motivator
Desc: This character gains a <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> SPD Amplification. After this character takes action, increases the ally squad's DMG Amplification by <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak>, stackable up to <unbreak>3[i]</unbreak> times.

Name: Sparkling Blue
Desc: All Protagonists gain "Sparkling Blue": Gain <unbreak>15%</unbreak> On/Off-Field Strength and 5% SPD Amplification. When entering a new Node, the "Sparkling Blue" holder provides "Sparkling Blue" to another character. Each "Sparkling Blue" holder grants that character 1 extra stack of bonus.

Name: Scapegoat
Desc: This character is sold when you are defeated in combat, and the combat is considered as a victory. Reselect Plot Armor.

Name: Self-Copy: Overload
Desc:
Every time after entering N new Nodes, obtain 1 copy of this unit, where N is equal to this unit's cost.
When obtaining this character, there is a <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> chance to obtain it 1 extra time.

Name: Lucky Hero
Desc: The character gains <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> Lucky Strike Rate. During battle, they gain Lucky Strike DMG equal to their Lucky Strike Rate.

Name: Soul Striker
Desc: After this character deals DMG, additionally deals 1 instance of True DMG equal to <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> of the original DMG.

Name: Windeye Knight
Desc: This character gains <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> SPD Amplification. At the start of this character's turn, they take a set amount of Wind Additional DMG equal to <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak> of their Max HP.

Name: Deliverer
Desc: This character loses all Bonds and becomes the "Deliverer":

Name: Destined Protagonist
Desc:
This character's Bond provides 2 Bond tallies.

***Only applies to Bonds that grant Emblems.***

Name: Sit-Ups
Desc:
When this character's HP falls below <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> of their Max HP, the following effects are triggered simultaneously:
① Restores full HP.
② Activates Ultimate.
③ Gains 1 extra turn.
④ DMG Amplification increases by <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak>, stackable.
This effect can be triggered up to <unbreak>3[i]</unbreak> time(s) per battle.

Name: Thick Armor Guard
Desc: The squad gains <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> DMG Mitigation. For each "<gridfightinfo type=item id=350206>" equipment this character equips, the squad gains <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak> DMG Mitigation.

Name: Battle for Gold
Desc: The character gains <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> Healing and Shield strength, and obtains 1 extra Encounter Reward in Encounter Nodes.

Name: Instant Promotion
Desc: If this character is a **1-cost character**, their star level temporarily increases by 1 before entering combat, up to a maximum of 4 stars.

Name: Even Warp
Desc: If this character is a **2-Cost character**, they are temporarily upgraded to 3-star before entering combat. When this character is upgraded to 3-star by merging, reselect Plot Armor.

Name: Even Formation
Desc: If this character is a **2-Cost character**, they gain <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> DMG Amplification. Each star rating of a **2-Cost character** on the field grants this character <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak> On-Field/Off-Field Strength.

Name: Triple Champion
Desc: If this character is 3-star, 3-cost, or has 3 pieces of equipment equipped, they gain <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> DMG Amplification and <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak> Lucky Strike DMG for each condition met. When all three conditions are met, the effect is doubled.

Name: Five-Crowned King
Desc: This character gains <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> Lucky Strike Rate and Lucky Strike DMG. If they are a **5-Cost character**, this amount is doubled.

Name: Genius Doctor
Desc: This character gains <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> Healing and Shield strength, and the ally squad gains <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak> HP Amplification.

Name: Inheritance of Will
Desc: This character transforms into a character of the same star rating that is 1 Cost higher, and Plot Armor is transferred to this new character.

Name: Speed Expert
Desc: The character gains a <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> SPD Amplification, and the SPD Amplification additionally increases by an amount equal to <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak> of the original SPD Amplification increase percentage.

Name: Blade Collector
Desc: Obtains an unremovable "<gridfightinfo type=item id=47030202> Component." For every "<gridfightinfo type=item id=350202>" equipped by the team, this character gains <unbreak>3[i]%</unbreak> On-Field Strength.

Name: Firearms Collector
Desc: Obtain the unremovable "<gridfightinfo type=item id=47030303> Component." For every "<gridfightinfo type=item id=350203>" equipped by the team, this character gains <unbreak>3[i]%</unbreak> Off-Field Strength.

Name: Boots Collector
Desc: Obtain the irremovable "<gridfightinfo type=item id=47030101> Component." For each "<gridfightinfo type=item id=350201>" equipped by the entire team, this character gains a <unbreak>3[i]%</unbreak> SPD Amplification.

Name: Social Master
Desc: Every <unbreak>2[i]</unbreak> times the Store is refreshed, 1 other character sharing any of this character's Bonds is guaranteed to appear. Each character on the field with the same Bond increases this character's DMG Amplification by <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak>.

Name: Basic ATK Elite
Desc: This character gains <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> DMG Amplification and <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak> Basic ATK DMG Amplification.

Name: Skill Elite
Desc: This character gains <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> DMG Amplification and <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak> Skill DMG Amplification.

Name: Poison Expert
Desc: When this character inflicts a debuff on an enemy, also inflicts them with "Deconstruct": After taking DMG, additionally takes 1 instance of True DMG equal to <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> of that DMG.

Name: Joint Follow-Up ATK
Desc: Gains the Bond "Joint Follow-Up ATK." Effective only for "Follow-Up ATK" characters:

Name: Skill Point Rewards Pool
Desc: Obtains the irremovable "Skill Point Ticket" Component. Consuming Skill Points allows you to draw for a random effect.

Name: Four-Dimensional Frenzy
Desc: Gains the Bond "Four-Dimensional Frenzy." Effective only for **4-Cost characters**:

Name: Armor Radiation
Desc: This character grants a <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> Lucky Strike Rate to all characters with the same Bond. If this Bond has at least <unbreak>2[i]</unbreak> characters, the characters additionally gain <unbreak>3[i]%</unbreak>.

Name: Enhancement Hormone
Desc: After this character advances the action of an ally character, all characters with their actions advanced gain <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> DMG Amplification.

Name: Star Hunt Oath
Desc: Gains the Bond "Star Hunt Oath":

Name: Passing the Torchflame
Desc: This character Stalls, and their attacks can only deal 1 DMG. During battle, for every 1 Gold Coin of value this character has, Slot 1 on/off-field characters gain <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> On/Off-Field Strength. True DMG will not be reduced.

Name: Seclusion
Desc:
The character temporarily leaves the field. After entering a number of Nodes, a 3-star version of this character is obtained. The higher the character cost, the longer it takes.

***This character will return to the preparation area and cannot be sold. Cards with the same name cannot be deployed. This Plot Armor does not take effect on characters with a special star rating.***

Name: Arrogant Giant
Desc: This character deals <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> of the original DMG. Deploying this character takes up 2 team slots.

Name: Rallying Hero
Desc: Each character sharing the same Bond as this character provides the current character with <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> On-Field/Off-Field Strength.

Name: Heavenly Great Khan
Desc: This character gains <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> On/Off-Field Strength. For every 1 non-independent Bond activated by the squad, the entire squad gains <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak> On-Field/Off-Field Strength, and this character additionally gains <unbreak>3[i]</unbreak> times this amount.

Name: Omni-Tier Resonance
Desc: This character's On-Field/Off-Field Strength increases by <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak>. When deployed characters include 1/2/3/4/5-Cost characters, this character gains <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak> Lucky Strike Rate.

Name: Future Reinforcement
Desc: A 2-star version of this character has a chance to appear in the Store.

Name: Alchemy
Desc: Immediately deducts <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> Gold Coins. After <unbreak>2[i]</unbreak> Node(s), obtain <unbreak>3[i]</unbreak> Gold Coins, and this character gains <unbreak>4[i]%</unbreak> On-Field/Off-Field Strength.

Name: Manic Streak
Desc: Upon a Perfect Clear, this character gains 1 stack of "Unstoppable": Increases On-Field/Off-Field Strength by <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> and SPD Amplification by <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak>. Otherwise, the number of stacks is halved.

Name: Apprenticeship
Desc: Obtained the Bond "Mentorship":
